---

## Problem statement

What engineering or research problem does this solve? Describe the use case,
not just the proposed feature.

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen. Sketches, pseudocode, or
references to how other tools (GFSSP, SINDA/FLUINT, OpenFOAM, etc.) handle it
are welcome.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you evaluated and why they fall short.

## Scope and impact

- Does this change persisted config / file formats? (Schema documentation must
  be updated.)
- Does it change numerical behavior of existing networks?
- Does it affect solver performance?

## Numerical claims (if applicable)

If the feature makes or changes a numerical claim, state the intended
reference, tolerance, units, and assumptions. New numerical behavior should
come with verification evidence (analytical checks, published benchmarks, or
regression tests).

## Additional context

Anything else: links to papers, related issues, mock-ups.
